text: No fires were detected on the property in the two weeks before 2026-10-04. Satellite data from NASA FIRMS (using VIIRS and MODIS sensors) showed no thermal anomalies within the asset boundaries during the period from 2026-10-04 to 2026-11-03. However, small, short-lived, or cloud-obscured fires might not have been detected. The assessment is based on full coverage of the area by all sensors throughout the evaluated period.
